notes: Torque (TGE/TGEA/Torque3D): the engine starts by executing main.cs at the game root, and ships its TorqueScript compiled to .cs.dso files beside or instead of the sources (https://github.com/TorqueGameEngines/Torque3D/blob/development/Templates/BaseGame/game/main.cs.in, https://docs.torque3d.org/for-programmers/torquescript). main.cs alone is not enough (a C# source file can carry the name), so it needs compiled scripts beside it. No enginehost plugin yet.
